dependency_installation_method: pip install minimal pinned dependencies + pip install --no-build-isolation --no-deps -e upstream

system_packages.notes: The validated smoke path succeeded without host ffmpeg. WAV decoding used the Python soundfile package in the virtual environment.

important_runtime_assumptions: WESPEAKER_HOME must point at the model-local checkpoints directory.
The upstream english alias must resolve to checkpoints/english containing avg_model.pt and config.yaml.
Two local lazy-import patches remain applied in the upstream working tree and are required for clean speaker-verification import/load.
